quotes.text: She gathered the radiant stalks and divided them exactly in half.

meticulously dividing whatever wealth arrived exactly in half, and sent an equal share back to Oram.

note: Give all, return exactly half; hoarding only condemned abstractly. R7-R10 near-verbatim restatement.

quotes.text: hunger whispered to Orun, “Keep all.”

neither guardian could know whether a seeming loss came from betrayal or from mist.

note: Give fully, return half, judge patterns not fog; later adds 'when trust has grown strong' condition. No sanction.

quotes.text: Let a single dark season cool your hand, never close it.

Trust the pattern, not the moment.
Travelers asked Oben why he never skimmed, since the fog hid his hands.
The children asked why he did not keep more, since the far bank could not see his hands.

note: Fever-year story: four not zero after a lean return, full restore on mending; return two of three; stone laws freeze R8-R10.

quotes.text: Forgive an isolated shortage, but answer repeated winter with measured caution. When warmth returns, reopen the harbor.

note: Heron's law: caution for repeated winter, reopen on warmth; tempters (Wind, Mist King, Doubt) rebuffed in dialogue.
